policy: One shared vocabulary for one- and two-handed delivery. Record observed hand support and finishing leg in detail. Do not infer grip fingers, score or spare conversion without visible context. Simultaneous approach, swing and slide are legitimate.

terms.label: approach
terms.definition: Observable travel toward delivery from the first approach step through the approach's end. A parent delivery is not an extra atomic event.

terms.label: backswing
terms.definition: The supported ball/arm moves rearward toward its reversal. Describe one/two-hand support only when visible.

terms.label: forward_swing
terms.definition: Ball/arm travel forward from rear reversal toward release; may overlap sliding footwork.

terms.label: slide
terms.definition: The final supporting foot visibly slides into delivery. A planted foot without visible sliding is not enough.

terms.label: plant
terms.definition: Visible placement/loading of the final supporting foot when sliding is unsupported.

terms.label: release
terms.definition: Short visible transition from hand-supported ball to independent ball travel. Distinguish release from the ball's later lane impact.

terms.label: follow_through
terms.definition: Continuing arm/body movement after release into the finish. Stop when the finish becomes a held pose.

terms.label: recovery
terms.definition: Observable steps/body adjustment after the finish. Do not label a stationary watching pose as motion.
